overview_description.description: Stash develops a personal finance application to combine banking, investing, and advice into one platform. Its application's services include personal investment accounts, retirement accounts, and custodial accounts for minors. It also provides the option to buy fractional shares of stocks, bonds, and funds with no add-on trading commissions to help users save small sums of money and make micro-investments.

about_short_description.short_description: Stash develops a personal finance application to combine banking, investing, and advice into one platform.

product.name: Personal Finance Application
product.description: A mobile and web application that integrates banking, investing, and financial advice into a single platform for personal financial management.

product.name: Custodial Investment Accounts
product.description: Investment accounts managed on behalf of minors, allowing adults to invest in stocks and ETFs for children until they reach the age of majority.

product.name: Early Direct Deposit
product.description: A banking feature that allows users to receive their paychecks up to two days earlier via direct deposit into their Stash banking account.

product.name: Stock-Back® Card
product.description: A debit card that rewards users with fractional shares of stock when they make purchases at participating brands.

product.name: Individual Retirement Accounts (IRAs)
product.description: Tax-advantaged retirement accounts including Traditional and Roth IRAs, allowing users to save and invest for retirement with potential tax benefits.

product.name: Smart Portfolio
product.description: An automated investing service that manages a diversified portfolio based on user goals and risk tolerance.
